crossRefs.note: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of…

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

translations.web: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
translations.bsb: “Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor?” Jacob asked. “We know him,” they replied.
